text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We must have done a lot of walking today
because my throat is bone-dry as
we head home. I
take out my water
bottle to quench my thirst.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer, have you been drinking
that tea
regularly?
choice_data_list: Drinking plum kelp tea outside rea...
Drinking plum kelp tea outside rea...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Nishino Flower taught me that
plum
kelp tea helps relieve fatigue, it's
become a
favorite of mine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
I'm so grateful for all the tidbits of
wisdom
the neighborhood grannies
taught me.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, it's been a huge help.
Thanks to you, it's been a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, all kinds of stuff... I can show you
if you
like?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we embark on Nishino Flower's

revitalization tour.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? Doesn't
gazing at
flowers while sunbathing just
boost your spirits?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Really? Yay! All right,
let's see what else
we can
do to unwind...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There! Let's go sit down on that bench!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower and I look out at the
flowers from
our seats.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... The fragrances of all those flowers are so soothing...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Gasp! I-I fell asleep!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! It's already evening... L-let's
move on to
the next spot!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious... These dried
persimmons are
nice and sweet...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It does for me too! One of the ladies in
my
neighborhood used to eat them with
me outside
the general store.
choice_data_list: It might be a nostalgic taste.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The nice clerk used to give us a few
extra for free,
too...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well, it wasn't all that long ago, now
that I think
about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The homely, laid-back nature of Nishino
Flower's tour fills me with a sense of
timeless nostalgia,
and I'm left
thoroughly refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think that's all we have time for
today.
...How was my tour?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.
choice_data_list: Thanks, it was a good day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You see, um... I've always worried that I
was
different.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The things I enjoy aren't quite like the
hobbies of
everyone else my age...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... I love taking it easy and spending
my time
peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I was younger, I really enjoyed
simple things, like feeling the warmth of
the sun while on
a walk with a
neighborhood granny.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The fact that I was able to share all
those
experiences with you...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Makes me happy as can be!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. But I still have a long ways to
go, seeing
how  I fell asleep mid-tour
and all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... Hehe! Thank you for
saying so.
choice_data_list: I feel bad just constantly being o...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure I'll be able to show you even
more
next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best for my considerate
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If things get any more relaxing than this,
I think
I'll be the one falling asleep next
time... Still, I'm looking forward to her
next tour.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?! Don't be silly!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who's always doing
everything to
support me... And I know I
can be a handful at
times!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Umm... Then I'll have to come up with an even more impressive way to thank you!
choice_data_list: Let me repay you someday, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue to debate who should be
thanking
whom the whole way home.
